provenance: Hand-authored for Slice 49 (Phase 3), testing whether two requested labels differing only by case survive as two distinct nodes rather than colliding -- Coral's ID derivation (labelToId) lowercases labels, so 'User Service' and 'user service' both derive to the id 'user_service' unless the model gives one an explicit `as "id"` clause
limitations: expectedSubstrings only checks that both label strings appear verbatim in the output text; a human must inspect the retained candidate DSL to confirm two distinct nodes.
